title: Law to let Council members appoint community board members
summary: This bill would amend the City Charter so Council members could directly appoint up to half of the members of community boards in their districts, rather than just nominating them for Borough President approval. It also requires borough presidents to report on coordination with Council members in recruiting board members and updates related rules on vacancies, removals and staff eligibility. The change would take effect only if approved by voters in a future general election.
